result.summary: This residential street features a sidewalk on the right side but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. Parked vehicles along the curb create significant visual obstructions that could hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles along the right curb blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or signage leaves pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: This is a low-density residential street with basic sidewalk infrastructure but a complete lack of formal crossing facilities. The environment relies on low traffic volumes for safety rather than intentional pedestrian-oriented design.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or signage to indicate where pedestrians should cross the street.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: The red truck parked on the street can block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Inaccessible curb
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the transition from the sidewalk to the street difficult or impossible for people with mobility aids.

interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at logical crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection or crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. The presence of parked vehicles and a trailer near the corner creates significant visual obstructions that hinder sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions creates a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: A trailer and parked vehicles are positioned very close to the intersection, blocking the view of approaching traffic for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs. The expansive, unmarked asphalt surface and presence of parked vehicles near corners create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians with potentially poor sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing areas are provided at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked, wide lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, open nature of the intersection increases the distance pedestrians must travel while exposed to vehicles and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street near the intersection
